reports.title: Phephisa Mabusa: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
categories: Community health care and emergency services related deaths

promises.quote: The Standard Operational Policy has been reviewed and the identified errors rectified. A memo has been sent to all clinicians within the service reminding them of the use of the UK Mental Health Triage Scale in informing their clinical judgment in the decision making process. This has also been shared with the leads covering the other CRS teams.
promises.summary: Rectify triage code errors in operational policy and disseminate correction

reports.title: Danny Anderson: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
categories: Community health care and emergency services related deaths

promises.quote: The Trust have made improvements, at pace in respect of the processes for formulation of risk on discharge with the implementation of discharge steps developed by the Trust Patient Flow Team. There has also been a change in practice to ensure we hold a discharge planning meeting with the Multi-Disciplinary Team (MDT) before discharge from hospital. Clinical service managers and matrons join discharge meetings to ensure a collaborative approach.
promises.summary: Implement discharge planning meetings with MDT and improve risk formulation processes

promises.quote: We can provide assurance that there is an expectation that care plans are reviewed as a minimum weekly or following any incidents or change. To further support this changes are being made to ensure care plans are discussed at the weekly MDTs.
promises.summary: Care plans reviewed weekly and discussed at MDTs

promises.quote: The Trust has initiated a Record Keeping Safety Improvement Programme (SIP). Part of this includes considering how to address issues of copying and pasting.
promises.summary: Record Keeping Safety Improvement Programme to address copying and pasting

promises.quote: A reflective learning supervision session has been held with a member of staff involved in this matter in order to understand the factors in this incident and ensure the staff member understands the importance of communication key information to other clinicians.
promises.summary: Reflective learning supervision for staff on risk communication

promises.quote: The Trust is rolling out STORM Training (Skills Training on Risk Management).
promises.summary: STORM Training rollout for risk management

promises.quote: The Trust has initiated a MDT Communication SIP due to the findings from patient safety incident investigations. A working group has been established consisting of senior clinicians and service directors to develop key principles for effective MDT working/communication and documentation.
promises.summary: MDT Communication SIP working group established

promises.quote: The Trust is continuing focus care planning and will be holding a dedicated Care Unit Local Quality and Safety Group to spotlight
promises.summary: Dedicated Care Unit Local Quality and Safety Group to spotlight care planning

reports.title: Julie Beasley: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
categories: Alcohol, drug and medication related deaths

promises.quote: The Trust has continued to review our assessment processes to ensure that the appropriate reviews are undertaken in a timely manner and are supported through the MDT approach which then supports a joined up approach to patient assessments. Staff in the Mental Health Crisis team are required to undertake a mental health assessment for all patients, which is monitored and audited via supervision meetings and compliance reviews.
promises.summary: Implement MDT-supported assessments and audits for all crisis team patients
